title: S-Paracompact Spaces with Respect to Closed Covers
content: We introduce and investigate a closed-cover version of S-paracompactness. Motivated by the notion of strongly S-closed spaces introduced by Dontchev, we replace open covers by covers consisting of closed sets and require locally finite closed refinements. We call such spaces closed S-paracompact. We establish basic properties of this notion, including its relationship with strongly S-closed spaces, compact spaces, Lindelöf-type properties, closed subspaces, continuous images, and finite unions. We also investigate the role of regularity and discuss the relationship between finite closed refinements and locally finite closed refinements. Several questions concerning products, hereditariness, and relationships with other covering properties are formulated. The construction is motivated by the closed-cover formulation of strongly S-closed spaces introduced by Dontchev [1]. In particular, our approach may be regarded as a paracompact-type extension of the closed-cover philosophy of strongly S-closed spaces.
